quests.title: A Message From the Junior

dialogue.t: Honorary Knight! We're so lucky to have you come and test out the entertainment stalls. It really puts my mind at ease!
This is actually my first time taking part in a development project, so I'm a little nervous. It's kinda frying my brain...
All I had to do was put a casing on an existing device. But there were so many design considerations, so many parameters to adjust...
I don't envy Captain Albedo, having to create purpose-built devices from scratch... It must be such a difficult task.

dialogue.sit: I think it's functioning really well.
Don't be hard on yourself. You can only get better.

dialogue.t: Wow, uh... Th—Thank you! Thanks, Honorary Knight, that means a lot coming from you!
I'll... I'll keep doing my best. Hopefully, I'll get to the point where I can build some useful stuff for the Reconnaissance Company...
Oh, I won a few toys in one of the games. I'd like you to have this one...
I have another one the same. Now, whenever I look at it, I'll think of all the encouragement you gave me!

quests.description: Mika seems to be looking for you…
